releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.6 PILOT promotion after successful HCSPC2025 DEV Terminal testing. Service 0.2.5.5 provides the isolated HWM Terminal fast channel over the existing authenticated /api/heartbeat transport. Terminal poll and result modes return before normal health, Mesh presence or remediation processing, so the proven device route is reused without generating false heartbeats or altering workstation health. Terminal remains one-shot PowerShell or CMD with short expiry, 15 second polling, maximum 60 second runtime, bounded output, operator audit identity and process-tree termination on timeout. Existing Headline Remote self-healing and Mesh recovery behaviour remain unchanged. Tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged. This PILOT promotion uses the exact DEV-tested package without rebuilding.
